an6.110:1.5: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an6.110:1.7: Kāmasaññāya pahānāya nekkhammasaññā bhāvetabbā, vyāpādasaññāya pahānāya avyāpādasaññā bhāvetabbā, vihiṃsāsaññāya pahānāya avihiṃsāsaññā bhāvetabbā.
an6.110:1.8: Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya ime tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā ti. 1.
